title: Normalized similarity objective for learned semantic state addressing
question: Does training the fixed 16-dimensional semantic state encoder with cosine-normalized margin similarity improve held-out retrieval compared with the existing raw dot-product objective?
hypothesis: H_cosine: score-scale variability in raw dot-product training contributes to the current retrieval boundary; cosine-normalized training should improve held-out target-state recall when both arms are evaluated with the same cosine retrieval metric.

arms.name: raw_objective
arms.intervention: existing raw dot-product margin objective with eight mean negatives

arms.name: cosine_objective
arms.intervention: L2-normalized cosine margin objective with eight mean negatives

endpoints.name: target_top1_recall
endpoints.role: primary — correct opaque persistent state selected under fixed cosine evaluation

endpoints.name: target_rank_mean
endpoints.role: secondary — mean rank under fixed cosine evaluation

decision_rule.condition: cosine_objective recall >= raw_objective recall + 0.10 and cosine_objective recall >= 0.50
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that normalized similarity is a material improvement to the current semantic state retriever
decision_rule.does_not_license: optimal normalization or general semantic retrieval

decision_rule.condition: cosine_objective recall is within 0.05 absolute of raw_objective recall
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that normalization does not materially change retrieval on this workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: that score geometry is irrelevant in other workloads

decision_rule.licenses: evidence that normalized similarity is harmful in this configuration
decision_rule.does_not_license: that cosine objectives are generally harmful

decision_rule.licenses: partial evidence that similarity geometry affects retrieval

held_constant: H=64 task anchor and A1 H-invariant query/state stream
dual linear input width=10 and latent width=16
one deterministic positive view per update
continuous state scoring with cosine similarity for both arms
no evaluation address or gold target enters training
prior C5 and learned-state results remain frozen
